test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A sum of Rs. 15,000 was lent for 3 years at the rate of 4%, 5%, 6% per annum, respectively, at compound interest for the first year. second year and third year compounded annually. Find the compound interest for 3 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 15,000

Rate for 1st year (R1) = 4%

Rate for 2nd year (R2) = 5%

Rate for 3rd year (R3) = 6%

Time (T) = 3 years

**Concept:**

Compound Interest (CI) is calculated on the initial principal, which also includes all the accumulated interest from previous periods on a loan or deposit.

**Formula Used:**

Amount after 1st year (A1) = P × (1 + R1/100)

Amount after 2nd year (A2) = A1 × (1 + R2/100)

Amount after 3rd year (A3) = A2 × (1 + R3/100)

Compound Interest (CI) = A3 - P

**Calculation:**

⇒ A1 = 15,000 × (1 + 4/100)

⇒ A1 = 15,000 × 1.04

⇒ A1 = 15,600

⇒ A2 = 15,600 × (1 + 5/100)

⇒ A2 = 15,600 × 1.05

⇒ A2 = 16,380

⇒ A3 = 16,380 × (1 + 6/100)

⇒ A3 = 16,380 × 1.06

⇒ A3 = 17,362.80

⇒ CI = A3 - P

⇒ CI = 17,362.80 - 15,000

⇒ CI = 2,362.80

**∴ The compound interest for 3 years is Rs. 2,362.80.**
